verdict.rationale: Zep's API is path-versioned (/api/v4 in the OpenAPI servers block) and its docs switch between v2, v3 and v4. It publishes dated deprecation waves that list removed methods with their replacements, plus a method-by-method v3-to-v4 migration map for Python, TypeScript and Go. Missing for 10: a standing deprecation policy stating guaranteed notice periods or support windows (the evidence shows individual dated waves, not a general policy), and independent or hands-on confirmation of how version transitions are handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
